name: tater-mcp
stderr:
This package is a name reservation, not the TATER MCP server.

The MCP server is distributed as source and run locally:

  1. Clone the TATER App repository
  2. cd tater-mcp && npm install && npm run build
  3. Point claude_desktop_config.json at the build output:

     "command": "node",
     "args": ["/full/path/to/tater-mcp/build/index.js"]

Full instructions: https://www.tatersecurity.com/Docs/Help/mcp-setup.html

Do not use `npx` for this server.
